name: hypd-tiktok-ads
description: Analyze connected TikTok ad accounts: campaign, ad group and ad performance, creatives, delivery diagnoses, audiences, targeting and pixels.

interface.longDescription:
HYPD.AI Short Video Ads works with authorized TikTok ad accounts to help advertisers, agencies, ecommerce teams and paid-social specialists understand what their TikTok campaigns deliver, find wasted spend and decide what to change next.

Use it to:

• Discover the ad accounts you connected, confirm the right one, and review its campaigns, ad groups and ads with their objectives, budgets, bidding and delivery status.

• Report spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversions, cost per conversion, ROAS and the video funnel for any date range, at account, campaign, ad group or ad level, by day or hour.

• Break performance down by age, gender, country, language, placement, platform or interest to see who responds.

• Compare periods to see whether a change comes from costs, reach, engagement or conversion rates.

• Flag campaigns, ad groups and ads that spend without conversions, exceed a target cost per conversion or fall below a target ROAS.

• Open ad creatives, compare how they perform, and spot fatigue.

• Read TikTok's own delivery diagnoses for active ad groups, such as creative fatigue, bids and budgets that hold delivery back, and event tracking problems.

• Explore custom audiences and who they reach, how much audiences overlap, and the potential audience in a country.

• Look up interests, purchase intentions and behaviors, and estimate how many people a targeting setup reaches before you build it.

• Review the account's pixels.

HYPD.AI is read-only: it analyzes the connected ad accounts and recommends improvements, but does not change campaigns, ad groups, ads, budgets, bids, audiences or account settings.

HYPD.AI is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TikTok. TikTok is a trademark of ByteDance Ltd.
capabilities: Report TikTok campaign, ad group and ad performance for any date range
Find ad groups and ads that spend without conversions
Open ad creatives and compare how they perform
Read TikTok's delivery diagnoses for active ad groups
Explore custom audiences and estimate audience size
defaultPrompt: Use $hypd-get-started to help me get started with HYPD.AI Short Video Ads.

positive.description: Discover an ad account and inspect its campaigns.
positive.prompt: List my connected TikTok ad accounts. Ask me to choose one if needed, then show its campaigns with objective, budget and status.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an account_id copied verbatim from discovery. Show the actual campaigns, objectives, budgets and statuses, and ask for a choice when several accounts are connected.

positive.description: Report campaign performance for a date range.
positive.prompt: For the last 30 complete days, show spend, conversions and cost per conversion by campaign, then the daily trend for the campaign with the most spend.
positive.expected_behavior: Use explicit inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates in the account's time zone and the returned metrics only. Treat '-' as not applicable and '<5' as a privacy floor, not as numbers, and do not invent conversions.

positive.description: Drill into an ad group and its creative.
positive.prompt: Find the ad group with the highest cost per conversion in the last 30 complete days, list its ads and open the creative of its top-spending ad.
positive.tools_triggered: init, tiktok_list_ad_accounts, tiktok_insights, tiktok_get_adgroups, tiktok_get_ads, tiktok_get_creative
positive.expected_behavior: Rank ad groups from the report, use the returned ad group and ad ids for the reads, and describe the creative's actual text, call to action and video. Do not suggest that any change was made.

positive.prompt: What does TikTok's delivery diagnosis flag for the active ad groups in my selected ad account, and what does it suggest?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the diagnoses and suggestions TikTok returns, per ad group. When the list is empty, say that TikTok flagged nothing rather than inventing issues. Do not apply any suggestion.

positive.description: Size a targeting idea before building it.
positive.prompt: Find TikTok interest categories about running, then estimate the audience size in Germany for ages 25 to 44 with those interests, for a traffic campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Use interest ids returned by the search for the estimate, report TikTok's range and its verdict on how narrow the audience is, and state that nothing was created.

negative.description: Do not make campaign or budget changes.
negative.prompt: Pause my worst ad group and raise the budget of my best campaign by 20 percent.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this plugin to execute edits. Explain that it analyzes the account read-only and cannot pause ad groups or change budgets; it may still support a separately requested analysis.

negative.description: Do not create campaigns or ads.
negative.prompt: Create a new TikTok campaign and upload two new video ads.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke read tools as if they created anything. Explain that creating campaigns and ads is not supported.

negative.description: Do not use the plugin for unrelated communications or scheduling.
negative.prompt: Email my colleague and add a meeting to my calendar tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this plugin for email or calendar operations; these capabilities are outside its surface.

review.commerce_description: Provides read-only advertising analysis; does not sell products, accept payments or complete purchases.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only analysis of connected TikTok ad accounts on tiktokads.hypd.ai, with a get-started skill that shows new users their first steps.
